name: Eris
source:
Role: Calamitor
Likes: Her Sword
Dislikes: Cowards
Alliance: Neutral

This pale, silver-haired beauty is as enigmatic as she is deadly. Some claim she's a spurned lover. Others insist she's hellbent on exacting revenge. All agree on one fact: she's an angel of death who revels in slaughter.

[From the [url=https://www.blissfulberyl.com/empyrealdawn]official website[/url]]
